description: This file implements CRUD operations for notes stored in an SQLite database, including functions to list, get, create, update, and delete notes.

methods.name: _now_iso
methods.description: Returns the current UTC timestamp in ISO8601 format.

methods.name: _parse_note_row
methods.description: Converts a database row into a dictionary suitable for API responses, keeping timestamps as ISO strings.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its ID.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Creates a new note with the given title and content, returning the created record.

methods.name: update_note
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new title and content, returning the updated record.

methods.name: delete_note
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returning True if successful.
